title: 💰 Nvidia Close to Buying Inception for Over $500 Million!
body: 💰 Nvidia Close to Buying Inception for Over $500 Million!

Nvidia is in advanced talks to acquire the startup Inception, developer of the “Mercury” AI models, in a deal exceeding $500 million plus bonuses tied to employee performance, according to press reports. Inception’s models stand out because they generate text by processing several parts in parallel at the same time, instead of word by word, reaching speeds of more than 1,000 tokens per second according to the company — up to ten times faster than traditional models. No agreement has been signed yet, and neither company has confirmed the talks, while Inception announced it is closing the Mercury API on December 28.
Simply put: current models write like a person writing one letter after another; diffusion models write like a team writing the whole page at once, so they finish much faster.
Would you prefer a faster model even if it is newer and less tested?
